purpose: Prove that regex, tree-sitter, SCIP, and LSP spellings of the SAME TypeScript re-export resolve to one provider-neutral CanonicalFactKey for the origin definition, while an alias rename (normalize -> canonicalize) keeps a distinct exported-symbol identity.
notes: regex and tree-sitter spellings are GROUND TRUTH from semidx.runtime.languages.typescript/parse-file. Both paths run re-export-defs; the tree-sitter path adds regex re-exports as supplemental defs, so the two agree.
SCIP and LSP spellings are REPRESENTATIVE provider-native forms, not verified tool output; Stage 3/5 must re-verify.

Module prefixes are expressed relative to a conceptual module root `src`. Concrete dotted module prefixes emitted by semidx depend on the index root path (ts-module-name derives the module from the file path).
